method: deterministic affirmative task-clause gates and explicit public benchmark profiles; no model evaluation, test claim or numeric score
basis: pm-selection-v2: user impact, material change, comparison task, benchmarkability, release conditions
generic_updates: Fixed various bugs and performance issues.

profiles.evidence_equals: On macOS, keyboard shortcuts assigned to Firefox menu items in System Settings now replace the built-in shortcuts for those items.
profiles.impact: macOS users can replace browser menu shortcuts with system preferences. This changes keyboard task completion and shortcut conflicts.
profiles.material_change: The official Beta note says custom shortcuts now replace built-in shortcuts; this is a historical Beta note, not a newly observed launch.
profiles.question: On the same macOS version, can a user override a browser menu shortcut through System Settings, and what happens to the former shortcut in Firefox and Samsung Browser if available?
steps: Confirm browser availability and the stated Beta behavior on the same macOS device
Assign a menu shortcut in System Settings
Invoke both the custom and former shortcuts while a page input has focus
Restore the original setting
metrics: Unexpected text input or conflicting commands
profiles.conditions: Beta documentation only; no device test. Confirm both browsers and menu support on macOS first. If Samsung Browser is unavailable on macOS, retain as a design comparison and do not report a cross-product performance result.
profiles.completion: Three repetitions per supported browser; record outcomes and unavailable paths. No execution is claimed.

profiles.evidence_equals: If enabled, the actor framework will capture screenshots by default when requested.
profiles.impact: An agent framework can capture page screenshots by default when requested. The default capture surface raises a concrete user-control and sensitive-page comparison task.
profiles.material_change: An active registration is documented at the pinned source baseline. This selects an existing experiment for research; it does not date its introduction or claim a new product release.
profiles.question: In a controlled browser-agent task, what page content enters a screenshot when observation is requested, and can the user inspect or stop that transfer?
steps: Build or obtain an accessible revision with this registration and confirm the actor path is present
Use synthetic pages with visible and off-screen markers
Request observation with the option enabled and disabled
Inspect captured markers and available user controls; compare another browser agent only if it supports the same task
profiles.conditions: Source-only baseline; installed availability, rollout and test results are unknown. Confirm platform/build access before executing. Use synthetic data in an approved test environment.
profiles.completion: Three repetitions for each supported condition; record setup and failures. No execution is claimed.

profiles.evidence_equals: Enable parallel downloading to accelerate download speed.
profiles.impact: A download can use parallel transfers. Download completion and recovery are concrete tasks; the source description is a claim to test, not proof of acceleration.
profiles.material_change: An active registration is documented at the pinned source baseline. This selects an existing experiment for research; it does not date its introduction or claim a new product release.
profiles.question: For an identical large file and controlled network, how do enabled and disabled parallel downloading affect completion time and recovery, and how does Samsung Browser behave under the same conditions?
steps: Confirm the flag exists in an accessible build and document default state
Serve a synthetic file from a server with range requests
Download with the option enabled and disabled under the same network cap
Repeat after one controlled network interruption and compare the same task in an available Samsung Browser build
profiles.conditions: Source-only baseline; installed availability, rollout and test results are unknown. Confirm platform/build access before executing. Use synthetic data in an approved test environment.
profiles.completion: Three repetitions for each supported condition; record setup and failures. No execution is claimed.

task_profiles.impact: Organize and recover a set of pages while completing a multi-page task.
task_profiles.question: How many steps and errors occur when organizing and restoring the same six-page task in each browser?
steps: Open six synthetic pages for two tasks
Perform the documented organization action
Switch tasks, close and restore the documented grouping if supported

task_profiles.impact: Understand and control a site request before access is granted.
task_profiles.question: For the documented resource request, can a user allow, deny and reverse the choice consistently across browsers?
steps: Use a synthetic site that requests only the documented resource
Record the prompt, deny access and retry
Allow access then find and revoke the site permission

task_profiles.impact: Recover an interrupted file transfer without losing the completed work.
task_profiles.question: How does each browser recover the same interrupted download under identical server and network conditions?
steps: Serve a synthetic large file with range requests
Interrupt the transfer at a fixed byte count
Perform the documented recovery action and verify the downloaded file hash

task_profiles.impact: Locate the right saved credential in a larger credential list.
task_profiles.question: Can a user find the same target credential with fewer wrong selections in each browser?
steps: Create an equal synthetic credential set with similar names
Use the documented search, filter or sort action
Find a specified entry and return to the original list

task_profiles.impact: Complete a page-reading task with assistant output that can be checked against the page.
task_profiles.question: For the same synthetic source pages, how accurate and controllable is the documented AI task in each available browser?
steps: Use synthetic pages with a fixed answer key
Invoke the documented AI action with the same task
Check statements and citations against the source and inspect available cancellation/data controls

task_profiles.announcement_pattern: \b(?:you|users?) can now copy (?:the )?(?:current )?tab(?:\x27s)? (?:URL|address) with a keyboard shortcut\b
task_profiles.experiment_pattern: \b(?:allows|enables) users to copy (?:the )?(?:current )?tab(?:\x27s)? (?:URL|address) with a keyboard shortcut\b
task_profiles.impact: Copy the current page address without leaving the keyboard task.
task_profiles.question: Can a user copy the same page URL while preserving input focus in each browser?
steps: Confirm or assign the documented shortcut
Focus a synthetic page input and invoke the shortcut
Paste into a separate synthetic field and verify the exact URL
